class_universal_task.select_encoding: select bits = big-endian binary digits of the lexicographic rank of the truth-table vector

B_BOOL2.generation_rule: complete enumeration of all boolean functions of 2 inputs in lexicographic truth-table order

B_BOOL3.generation_rule: complete enumeration of all boolean functions of 3 inputs in lexicographic truth-table order

B_DELAY.generation_rule: complete lag range 0..l_max with l_max derived by the state-domain counting bound; stream = de Bruijn sequence B(2, l_max+1) so every binary (l_max+1)-gram occurs exactly once (full input-history coverage)

class_universal_task.select_encoding: rule bits = rule number in big-endian (left,center,right) canonical order

B_LOCAL.generation_rule: complete enumeration of all 256 elementary local rules (every function of the 3-site neighborhood) on a ring over all 2^w ring states
